name: Create Opening (Combat)
body:
You hamper your opponent’s ability to defend herself against a physical attack.

Prerequisite: Int 13, Combat Expertise

Benefit: Once per encounter you can, with a successful combat maneuver, inflict a –5 circumstance penalty to your opponent’s armor class for one round.

Special: With the GM’s permission you can attempt this maneuver without the use of this feat. Doing so provokes an attack of opportunity which causes the maneuver to fail if it hits.
